papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.subtitle: Kaplan et al., OpenAI, 2020
papers.tldr: 语言模型损失随参数量、数据量、算力呈幂律下降；固定算力下应优先放大模型并早停。

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.subtitle: Hoffmann et al., DeepMind, 2022
papers.tldr: Chinchilla 重新估计算力最优缩放：模型参数和训练 token 应近似等比例增长。

papers.title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks
papers.subtitle: Shazeer et al., Google Brain, 2017
papers.tldr: 稀疏门控 MoE 让模型拥有巨大总参数量，但每个输入只激活少数专家。

papers.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
papers.subtitle: Wang et al., NVIDIA, 2026
papers.tldr: LocateAnything 用 Parallel Box Decoding 把框作为几何单元并行生成，在视觉 grounding 中同时提升速度和高 IoU 定位质量。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Transformers: A Sparse and Scalable Architecture for Multi-Modal Foundation Models
papers.subtitle: Liang et al., Stanford / Meta, 2025
papers.tldr: MoT 按模态拆分 Transformer 的非 embedding 参数，同时保留全局 self-attention，让多模态预训练用更少 FLOPs 达到 dense baseline 质量。

papers.title: Why Video Gen Is an Infra Problem
papers.subtitle: Chen et al., NVIDIA, 2026
papers.tldr: 视频生成正在从漂亮 demo 转向端到端基础设施问题：长时记忆、VAE 解码、KV cache、低精度、并行和调度共同决定可用性。

papers.title: Data Journalist Agent: Transforming Data into Verifiable Multimodal Stories
papers.subtitle: Lin et al., Oxford / Stanford, 2026
papers.tldr: Data2Story 用多智能体虚拟 newsroom 把原始数据变成可读的多媒体新闻网页，并用 Inspector 将 claim 绑定到代码、数据或外部来源。
